statement: NVIDIA will invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy, alongside a cited $4.2 billion regional grid investment with AEP Ohio tied to at least 10 gigawatts of new generation
why: The chip vendor putting its own balance sheet behind the power developer that houses its customers is vendor-supplied financing, which loosens the capital constraint on the marginal buyer.

impact.mechanism: Vendor equity into the site developer plus utility-scale grid spend eases the financing and power bottleneck that would otherwise limit how fast buyers can absorb accelerators.

confidence.basis: Investment figures stated verbatim in NVIDIA's own press release; no credit-condition index value is asserted because the release gives none.
